content: Balâmu ashubigisha Israheli
Balâmu abona oku Nyamubâho arhonyize okugisha Israheli, lêro arhacijaga nk’agandi mango ebwa kugendidôsa embuko, ci ayêrekeza obusù bwâge ebwa irungu.
Erhi Balâmu abà amâyinamula amasù, abona oku bene Israheli bahanzire ishanja oku lindi, anaciyagânwa na Mûka gwa Nyamuzinda,
aderha ecinwa câge, erhi:
Obugeremwa bwa Balâmu mwene Beori, Obugeremwa bwa omuntu onizire isù,
Obugeramwa bwa olya muntu oyumva ebinwa bya Nyamuzinda, Kubona abona ebi Ogala-byoshi ayêrekana, anahâbwe n’ishuzo limâna n’amasù gâge gabungûke.
Alà oku gayinjiha amahêma gâwe Yakôbo! n’enyumpa zâwe, Israheli!
Nka kula orhubanda rhulanduka, nka kula amashwa mahinge oku lwîshi, nka binûsi Nyamubâho arhwêraga, nka kula emiyerezi elandira oku burhambi bw’amîshi.
Amîshi ganasheshe ebi bindi byâge, n’emburho yâge egundumuke enyanya ly’ago mîshi manji, omwâmi wâge ayisha ayêrêra enyanya ly’Agagi, n’obwâmi bwâge bwajire irenge!
Nyamuzinda amurhenza e Mîsiri: amuhà emisî eri nka ya mbogo. Yamalîra amashanja gashingalala embere zâge. Yabavunangula orhuvuha, anabatyabule n’emyampi yâge.
Anagonye amadwî, acîbundike nka ntale ndume, nk’amacîbundika nka nsimba, ndi wankacimuzûsa? Agishwe, owâkugishe n’owakuhinde, akahindwa!
Oburhè bwa Balaka bwayâka bwenêne kuli Balâmu, ashûrha omu nfune, amubwîra erhi: «Nalikuhamagala nti ohehêrere abashombanyi bâni, wêhe kwamabà kubagisha kasharhu.
Na buno yimukaga duba olibirhire emwâwe! Nali ndesire nti nakujira oj’irenge; lêro lolà oku Nyamubâho amakuyegûla kuli lyo.»
Balâmu anacishuza Balaka erhi: «Ka ntali erhi nabwîzire entumwa wali orhumire, oku:

Ciru Balaka akampa enyumpa yâge eyunjwîre nfaranga na masholo, ntakavuna irhegeko lya Nyamubâho, omu kujira niene nk’oku nnonzize okujira ehinja erhi ehibî; n’oku ngasi oku Nyamubâho anadesire kwo naderha?
Alaga oku bunôla nkola nacîshubirira emw’olubaga lwâni; yishaga nkubwîre ehi olu lubaga lwanajirîre olubaga lwâwe omu nsiku zàyisha».
Okuhandi anaciderha ebi binwa, erhi:
Bugeramwa bwa Balâmu mwene Beori, bugeramwa bw’omuntu wanizire isù,
bugeramwa bw’olya muntu oyumva ebinwa bya Nyamuzinda ye oyishi eby’Ow’Enyanya ye olya obona ebyanacibonwe by’Ogala-byoshi olya okûmba bûbi anagalirhondêra abona.

Namamubona, ci kwône arhacibà wa buno; namamulâba ci kwône arhacibà nk’oli hôfi. Enyenyêzi yamârhenga muli Yakôbo, akarhi k’obwâmi kamayimanga omu Israheli; kamavunanga emyanganga ya Mowabu, Kamamalîra bene Seti.
Ecihugo c’Edomu camagwârhwa busâsa, na Seyiri kwo n’okwo; Israheli amâlambûla obuhashe bwâge.
Emwa Yakôbo yamârhenga omurhegesi ye wamalîra ngasi bicisigîre omu ngo na Edomu.
Balâmu abona Amaleki, anacimubwîra ebi binwa, erhi: «Amaleki lyo ishanja likulu omu mashanja, n’obuzinda bwâge kwabà kushâbûka».
Balâmu anacibona bene Keneti, anaciderha, erhi: Aha mwinyu bahazibuhize, ewe Kayini, n’enyumpa zinyu ziri nyûbake oku ibuye.
Ci kwônene olugo lwinyu lubà lwa Beori; amango gahi mwanarhenge omu bujà bwa Asûru?
Balâmu ashubirira aderha ebi binwa, erhi: Aye, amashanja g’emashinji gabugânana emwênè,
n’enkugè olunda lw’e Kitimi. Gamalibûsa Asûru, gamabengeza Eberi; naye obuzinda bwâge kuli kuherêrekera lwoshi.
Balâmu erhi abà amayimuka, ahuma njira, acîshubirira emwâge; naye Balaka ajà lwâge lunda.
